source_text: Interiora auro; exteriora pellibus. Gloria occultanda; humilitas foris. Arca in sanctis sanctorum — cor ubi Christus habitat.
pass_a_gloss: Interiors with-gold; exteriors with-skins. Glory to-be-hidden; humility outside. Ark in holies of-holies — heart where Christ dwells.
pass_b_english: Within, gold; without, skins. Hide glory; wear humility outside. The ark in the holy of holies is the heart where Christ dwells.
